Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that streams audio chunks from an async source using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import asyncio
import websockets
import json

API_ENDPOINT = "wss://api.concreteprovider.com/v1/streaming_transcription"

async def stream_audio(audio_chunks):
    async with websockets.connect(API_ENDPOINT) as websocket:
        async for chunk in audio_chunks:
            await websocket.send(json.dumps({"chunk": chunk}))
            
        response = await websocket.recv()
        transcript = json.loads(response)["transcript"]
        return transcript

# Example usage
async def main():
    async def audio_source():
        # Simulated async audio chunk generator
        for i in range(5):
            yield "audio_chunk_" + str(i)
            await asyncio.sleep(1)

    transcript = await stream_audio(audio_source())
    print("Transcript:", transcript)

asyncio.run(main())
